How to use this lesson

Tap the pictures and word tiles as the children call them out. For the bird poem, tap 1 then 2 and say the line together. In the rain poem, tap each picture to reveal and hear its line.

Again repeats the last sound. Back and Next change pages only when you press them. Press N to show or hide teacher notes. In Google Meet, share the browser tab and its audio.
